loading.title: Loading Atelier projection
loading.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: loading owns the surface and hides stale stream content.

empty.title: No Atelier tasks yet
empty.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: empty state is distinct from disconnected or auth-denied recovery.

ready.title: Atelier projection ready
ready.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: ready state exposes the steady projection surface without recovery affordance.

reconciling.title: Reconciling Atelier projection
reconciling.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: reconciling preserves visible projection while the stream catches up.

degraded.title: Atelier projection degraded
degraded.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: degraded keeps the last projection visible without exposing execution recovery.

disconnected.title: Projection stream disconnected
disconnected.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: existing projection remains visible while retry stays projection-only.

auth-denied.title: Atelier access denied
auth-denied.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: auth denied is non-retryable and does not expose execution capability.

error.title: Atelier projection error
error.detail: Controlled prototype scenario: generic errors use projection-only retry and preserve existing stream content.

loading.title: 正在加载 Atelier projection
loading.detail: 等待 Desktop Host 通过 applet bridge 返回 Station workspace snapshot。

ready.title: Projection 已连接
ready.detail: 正在消费 Station / Agent orchestration 投影事件。

reconciling.title: Projection 正在同步
reconciling.detail: 已保留当前 snapshot，正在连接 Desktop Host 的 Atelier projection event stream。

degraded.title: Projection 降级
degraded.detail: 收到过期 projection event，已拒绝应用并保留最后一份有效 snapshot。

auth-denied.title: Atelier 权限被拒绝
auth-denied.detail: 当前 applet session 没有 Atelier projection capability，或登录身份已失效。

disconnected.title: Projection 连接中断
disconnected.detail: Desktop Host 暂时无法连接 Station projection stream；当前页面保留最后一次 snapshot。

error.title: Projection 加载失败
error.detail: Host bridge 返回了无法识别的 projection 响应。

directRunExecutionEvidence.source: agent_direct_runs + agent_task_runs + agent_task_events + agent_task_artifacts + agent_task_gate_results + agent_task_budget_usages

doesNotProve: real Station artifact blob production by provider/executor
real iframe/image/html/diff rendering in a live Desktop webview
real artifact blob fetch from Station storage
